JANUS HENDERSON FUND MANAGEMENT UK LIMITED
THE EUROPEAN SMALLER COMPANIES TRUST PLC
THE EUROPEAN SMALLER COMPANIES TRUST PLC

The Company announces that it is satisfied that all inside information which the directors and the Company may have, in the period leading up to the announcement of the results in respect of the financial year ended 30 June 2026, has previously been published or notified via a Regulatory Information Service ('RIS'). Therefore, the Company is not prohibited from dealing in its own securities.

If, in the period leading up to the announcement of the annual results, the directors of the Company come into possession of any inside information, this will be notified to an RIS before any such transactions are undertaken.
Janus Henderson Secretarial Services UK Limited
Corporate Secretary to The European Smaller Companies Trust PLC
